scoring_justification: Young's modulus can be recomputed from the stress-strain data by linear fitting in the strain interval 0.03-0.05, and the paper provides the gold values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Young's modulus gold values for diameters 2,3,4,6 nm
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Section 3.1: 'The Young's moduli of the four types of single-crystal Cu nanopillars in the strain range from 0.03 to 0.05 are 90.2, 103.6, 112.4, and 124.5 GPa, respectively.' Also Table 1.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported simulation results; they are traceable and used as the reproduction target.

outputs.description: Raw stress–strain data points for Cu nanopillars; the checker will recompute Young's modulus from these points in the strain range 0.03–0.05.
Self-reported Young's modulus values for each diameter; the checker compares these to the paper-derived hidden reference.

output_contract.notes: The hidden grading specification bundles paper-reported Young's moduli as gold; the checker recomputes moduli from stress_strain_data.json and also verifies young_moduli.json against the same hidden reference.
